secondary_scoring_audit.reason: Original v1 scorer queried English FTS terms for Arabic source context, raised PolicyReviewRequired and lost the candidate ID in its exception path. Existing real responses are audited with their exact permitted policy references. This is secondary post-hoc scoring, not new inference or silent replacement of the primary failed-case denominator.

rag.reason: Original source allowlist omitted services/agents/knowledge.json; original retrieval_hash covered pathway files rather than the actual SQLiteFTS knowledge pack.
rag.original_hash_scope: pathway source files only; not an initial byte capture of the actual RAG pack
rag.source_unchanged_claim: Owner implementation agent reports knowledge pack unchanged since development validation. Independently every observed full section/metadata/citation is byte-content equivalent to this capture; actual provider inputs retain those sections and their original call hashes.

disjoint_properties: patient IDs across development/validation/holdout split names
final live input records were not used for semantic prompt optimization
overlapping_properties: same six variant structures per function
same task/scenario family operators and care-rule vocabulary
split.labels_are_not_evidence: Different template_family strings include split prefixes; these do not demonstrate structurally disjoint scenario or text families.
split.offline_layer_note: Some synthetic patient identifier ranges also occur in the offline known-regression suite; actual persisted case IDs and evidence layers are separate. Do not claim global patient-family independence across software and model evidence layers.
split.allowed_claim: Executed bounded conformance on known scripted scenario/template families with disjoint split IDs/seeds, plus adapted public conversation rubric estimates.
split.unsupported_claim: Unseen-family generalization, representative clinical performance, independent clinical validation or patient outcome improvement.
split.original_limitations_erratum: Any original manifest/header text implying disjoint template/scenario families is superseded by this explicit measurement limitation. Raw inputs, scores, original hashes and selected-case denominators remain unchanged.
split.future_work: Implement v2 truly distinct text/interaction-family generator and tests without overwriting v1 cases; an additional authorized budget/new untouched dataset version is required for new live generalization evidence.

backend_actual_first_import.reason: Instrumentation-only source capture added before DomainHarness first import to distinguish final backend security repairs from earlier model-source freeze; no model/prompt/RAG/scorer/truth/command changes.
backend_actual_first_import.prior_backend_captures: Earlier scheduler-resume/prejourney captures are intermediate; this execution-time capture governs actual fulljourneys. Raw case backend_source_hash from the scheduler is a resume-point label, not a replacement for this phase evidence.
